formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p14_t3_softmax_shift_and_normalization {n : Nat} (x : Fin n -> Real) (a : Real) (j : Fin n) : softmax (x-a) j = softmax x j /\ normalized and absolute-mass identities
formal_statement.plain_language: Softmax is unchanged by a common shift, and its nonnegative components have ordinary and absolute sums equal to one.

informal_proof: Factor exp(-a) from the numerator and denominator, cancel it using positivity of exponential sums, sum the exact quotient components, and use one-signed absolute-sum equality.
informal_statement: Exact invariant package connecting the shifted softmax formula (1.4) with the normalization value 1 used in the experiments.
